title: BioRad C1000 Touch thermal cycler
manualMd: 96-well thermal cycler with a fast block. Programs are saved per user. Use the heated lid (105 °C default) for any cycle longer than ~30 min to prevent condensation on tube caps.
hazardsMd:
- Block reaches 95 °C. Don't touch immediately after a run.
- Heated lid stays hot after the program ends.

operations.title: Daily check
operations.bodyMd: Inspect the block for spilled liquid; clean with a damp Kimwipe and dry. Confirm the heated-lid surface is clean — residue impairs heat transfer.

operations.title: Standard PCR program
operations.bodyMd: Initial denat 95 °C / 3 min → 30× (95 °C / 30 s, Ta °C / 30 s, 72 °C / 30 s per kb) → final ext 72 °C / 5 min → hold 4 °C. Always set the heated lid for cycle programs >30 min.

operations.title: Block won't heat to spec
operations.bodyMd: Most often caused by spilled liquid in the wells creating cold spots. Power off, dry the block thoroughly, restart. If readings are still off, run the built-in self-test.

operations.title: Tube collapse
operations.bodyMd: Cheap or off-brand tubes can deform under heated-lid pressure. Switch to PCR-grade thin-wall strip tubes.

operations.title: Post-use
operations.bodyMd: Remove all tubes. Inspect for any spilled reaction. Wipe and close the lid. Log out.
